column1: # Units that must be enabled for this host to behave as designed.
# Enabled state is NOT captured by tracking unit files: it lives in
# Restore the config, forget to enable, and the thing silently never runs.
# borgmatic.timer is the sharp example -- its unit is distro-provided, so
# nothing in this repo would otherwise say that backups are supposed to run.
# fstrim is tracked as MASKED, not merely absent: this file exists so that a
# restored host behaves as designed, and 'nobody re-enabled fstrim' is part of
# that. Both disks report DISC-GRAN=0B -- they cannot discard at all.
